title: TranscriptRowPayloads
description: C-5 payloads of context rows (transcript.md). Written by the adapter's TranscriptStore for the `harness`; read by projection, fork, resume, and the Workbench model view. All shapes are persisted and versioned.

ModelInput.description: `messages.content_json.model` on user, harness, agent_initiated, and annotation rows, set when the loop consumes the input.

message.description: The input exactly as sent, including the rendered time and identity prefix and attachments.
Verbatim, including quick-reply blocks and file:// links that the display copy rewrites.

request.description: C-9 (context.md section 2): the request this response answered, as sent, for the estimate anchor. Written only when context management is on.

tokens.description: UTF-8/4 tokens of the whole request: system prompt, tool definitions, and messages.

recovered.description: Committed by T2 settlement (recovery.md) after the call's run ended, not by the tool.

skills.description: Set when the result carries skills `vibe skill load` loaded: one entry per top-level `<skill_content name>` block, in load order; the names a checkpoint lists. The result clears like any other.

Compaction.description: `agent_events.content_json` of a `context_compaction` row (context.md section 7). Its model-facing content (`summary`, `state`) is fixed when it is written, so projection is a pure function of the rows.

mode.description: `normal`: the fork summarized the whole conversation and the tail stays verbatim; `rolling`: the fork summarized the prefix up to the cut (overflow ladder b); `dropped`: the prefix moved out with no model call (overflow ladder c).

summary.description: The rendered `<context-checkpoint>` message: framing, checkpoint, `<artifacts>`, `<skills-loaded>`, and `<earlier-record>`. Model-facing. The in-flight Turn's inputs before the cut (`kept_inputs`) stay in the projected context as they were, right before this message (context.md section 5).

checkpoint.description: The model-written checkpoint. For `dropped`, the previous checkpoint's text, or empty when there was none or it was too large for the route (context.md section 8 c).

state.description: State the adapter rendered from its own stores when the checkpoint was written (the environment's core fields); each is one text block after `summary`. Model-facing.

first_kept_seq.description: `context_seq` of the first unit kept verbatim.

kept_inputs.description: `context_seq` of each input of the in-flight Turn (its first and every accepted steer) before `first_kept_seq`, ascending: projection keeps them verbatim, in order, right before this row's message (context.md section 5). Empty when the cut did not fall inside that Turn.

summarized_to_seq.description: The last `context_seq` moved out of the context; the `<earlier-record>` hint names it.

files_read.description: Paths given to `read` and never to `write` or `edit`, cumulative, most recently touched first as the calls gave them, at most 50; only the summary's display is cut.

files_read_omitted.description: Whether a read path was ever pushed out of `files_read`; once set, it stays set. A mark, not a count: a path pushed out and touched again is the same path.

files_modified.description: Paths given to `write` or `edit`, cumulative, most recently touched first as the calls gave them, at most 50; only the summary's display is cut.

files_modified_omitted.description: Whether a modified path was ever pushed out of `files_modified`; once set, it stays set.

skills.description: Names of the skills the summarized rows loaded, cumulative, minus those whose load result is still in the context: the most recently loaded first, at most 20, as loaded. Listed by name in `summary` (`<skills-loaded>`, each displayed as one line of plain text); never their bodies.

skills_omitted.description: Whether a skill name was ever pushed out of `skills`; once set, it stays set.

threshold.description: T when the checkpoint was written; ineffective when `tokens_after_estimate >= 0.75 * threshold`.

rounds.description: Responses of the checkpoint turn that called tools: at most 5 rounds whose calls ran, plus one answered with the used-up budget text.

usage.description: Summed over the checkpoint turn's responses.

target_event_id.description: The `tool_result` row whose content is replaced in projection.

reason.description: `clear_old_tool_result` replaces an old result with the cleared placeholder (context.md section 4); `fit_tool_result` shows the newest batch's result cut to fit, ending with its note (section 3). The row keeps the whole output either way.

AgentState.description: `agent_events.content_json` of an `agent_state` row: hook state at a commit point (loop-control.md section 7). Not projected into messages.

ForkTurn.description: `agent_events.content_json` of a `fork_turn` audit row (`TranscriptStore.append_audit(kind='fork_turn')`, `visibility = 'audit'`, no `context_seq`): one side turn (C-10 fork.md section 7), such as a C-9 checkpoint turn, and the messages it produced, from the attempt ledger. Written once on every exit but an abort (C-10 F7). Never context.

purpose.description: What the side turn is for; grows with its consumers (C-10 section 13).

policy.description: The side-turn policy its calls ran under (C-10 section 6).

point.description: The fork point (C-10 section 2): the caller's latest committed context_seq, and the number of units of that view the prefix kept (null: all of them).

detail.description: Purpose fields. For `checkpoint`: the C-9 reason and mode (context.md section 6).

folded_event_id.description: The row the caller's fold committed (for a checkpoint, its `context_compaction` row), or null.

messages.description: Every attempt's response or partial (failed and retried ones included) and the turn's tool results, in order; a refused response that JSON cannot hold is left out (context.md section 10, invariant 6).

ModelAttempt.description: `agent_events.content_json` of a `model_attempt` audit row (`TranscriptStore.append_audit(kind='attempt')`, `visibility = 'audit'`, no `context_seq`): a conversation attempt that reported usage and did not become a response row (retried, relieved, a usage-only terminal, refused at admission, or a failed commit), written by the attempt ledger in every mode, with or without context management (context.md section 10, invariant 4). Never context.

error.description: Why the attempt did not become a response: the provider error that ended it (`<kind>: <message>`), or, without one, why the model call ended (a refusal at admission, a failed commit).

examples.summary:
<context-checkpoint>
This is a record of the earlier part of this conversation, written for you so you can continue. ...

# 1. Self and method
...

<artifacts>
Read:
- tests/test_paths.py
Modified:
- core/paths.py
</artifacts>
<earlier-record>
...
</earlier-record>
</context-checkpoint>
